## Setup - Run in console


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries (make sure to install these first manually in the Console)
library(rmarkdown)
library(here)
```



```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# works whether current wd is project root or src
if (basename(getwd()) == "src") {
  parent_dir <- dirname(getwd())
} else {
  parent_dir <- getwd()
}

# codes should be parent_dir/src
codes <- file.path(parent_dir, "src")

render(file.path(codes, "sub", "PPP_last_name_predict.Rmd"))
render(file.path(codes, "sub", "PPP_WRU_predict.Rmd"))
render(file.path(codes, "sub", "PPP_BIFSG_predict.Rmd"))
render(file.path(codes, "sub", "PPP_birdie_predict.Rmd"))
```
